 A grandmother unearthed a medieval gold cross while metal detecting on an island with historic ties to King Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn. Now, she's hoping the potentially valuable treasure could have a royal connection. 
 A medieval gold cross potentially worth $27,000 was discovered on England's Isle of Sheppey, where King Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn visited in 1532. The woman who found it hopes the artifact may be linked to the royal couple, though no connection has been established.
